codes.label: Policy and fiscal incentives
codes.definition: Public policy instruments, laws, targets, subsidies, tax and tariff incentives, or their absence or misalignment (including fossil-fuel subsidies), that shape technology adoption.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include named laws/programmes (Law 1715, Law 2099, PROURE, FENOGE), tax deductions, VAT/tariff exemptions, feed-in schemes, subsidies, national targets and roadmaps, policy support/continuity.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude detailed technical rules, permits and market rules (regulatory-framework); private/credit financing (capital-financing).

codes.label: Regulatory framework and permitting
codes.definition: Regulations, market and grid-connection rules, standards, licensing and permitting procedures, and legal clarity (or gaps) governing the technology.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include CREG/UPME/ANLA resolutions, net-metering and self-generation rules, licensing delays, regulatory uncertainty, missing technical standards or codes, legal definitions, environmental licensing.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude incentive design (policy-fiscal-incentives) and institutional coordination between agencies (institutional-governance).

codes.label: Capital costs and access to finance
codes.definition: Upfront investment burden and availability, cost, or structure of finance (credit, funds, investors, risk guarantees, international climate finance).
codes.inclusion_notes: Include high initial/capital costs, lack of credit or capital, financing schemes, microfinance, green bonds, funds, investment risk perception, payback/financing terms, project finance, investor confidence.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude running-cost or LCOE competitiveness (economic-viability) and tax incentives/subsidies (policy-fiscal-incentives).

codes.label: Cost competitiveness and economic viability
codes.definition: Operating costs, levelised costs, price competitiveness against incumbents and cost-benefit performance that decide whether a project pays off.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include LCOE, operating/maintenance costs, high tariffs or energy prices, cost reductions from learning, economies of scale, low fossil prices undermining competitiveness, NPV/IRR, avoided cost savings.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude upfront capital and finance access (capital-financing).

codes.label: Market structure, demand and supply chain
codes.definition: Size and structure of demand, competition, business models, supply chains, imports and offtake conditions that determine whether a market for the technology exists.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include low/uncertain demand, market concentration, lack of ESCO/business models, auctions and PPAs as demand guarantees, import dependence, local manufacturing, feedstock supply markets, export opportunities, market creation.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude price/cost competitiveness (economic-viability) and rule design (regulatory-framework).

codes.label: Grid and physical infrastructure
codes.definition: Adequacy of electricity grids, transmission, connection capacity, fuel/charging/hydrogen/storage infrastructure and physical accessibility of sites.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include weak or absent grid (ZNI), transmission delays, congestion, remote location and difficult access, charging or hydrogen refuelling networks, smart-meter/AMI roll-out as infrastructure, logistics and transport networks, existing infrastructure that can be reused.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude resource quality (resource-availability) and device-level performance (technology-performance).

codes.label: Technology maturity and technical performance
codes.definition: Technical maturity, reliability, efficiency, intermittency, integration and operation-and-maintenance characteristics of the technology itself.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include intermittency/variability, low inertia, immature or unproven technology, lack of local validated models, efficiency, equipment quality, storage/hybridisation solutions, modularity, technological advances, technical complexity, maintenance difficulty, cybersecurity.

codes.label: Institutional capacity and governance
codes.definition: Capacity, coordination, continuity and integrity of public institutions and multi-actor governance, including political commitment and partnerships.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include weak institutions, lack of coordination between agencies or with industry, fragmented responsibilities, poor planning, corruption, governance, political instability, public-private-academic alliances, international cooperation, institutional commitment and leadership.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude the content of rules (regulatory-framework) and incentive design (policy-fiscal-incentives).

codes.label: Social acceptance, community and behaviour
codes.definition: Public and community attitudes, participation, behaviour, conflict, land and cultural fit that facilitate or block adoption.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include community opposition, social licence, protests, prior consultation outcomes, armed conflict/insecurity, land tenure and displacement, resistance to change, user habits and rebound behaviour, cultural compatibility, trust, ethnic communities, gender, social equity, community ownership, opinion leaders.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude lack of technical knowledge or skills (knowledge-capacity) and legal consultation procedures (regulatory-framework).

codes.label: Knowledge, skills and R&D capacity
codes.definition: Availability of technical skills, training, awareness, information, data, research and innovation capacity.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include lack of trained personnel, low awareness or knowledge of technology/benefits, training programmes, education, R&D funding and capacity, data/information gaps and open datasets (e.g. wind atlas), technology transfer, knowledge management, studies and assessments.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude behavioural resistance (social-acceptance) and equipment availability (market-supply-demand).

codes.label: Natural resource and feedstock availability
codes.definition: Quality, quantity and seasonality of natural energy resources, feedstock, land and water, and geographic/climatic conditions.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include solar irradiation, wind speed, hydro/geothermal/biomass potential, feedstock and residue availability, seasonal complementarity, El Nino/climate variability, water scarcity, land availability, lack of resource at a site.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude environmental protection constraints and climate-policy motives (environmental-climate).

codes.label: Environmental constraints and climate drivers
codes.definition: Environmental protection limits, impacts and climate-mitigation or air-quality motives that restrict or drive adoption.
codes.inclusion_notes: Include ecosystem/protected-area limits, deforestation, emissions and pollution concerns, climate commitments and carbon markets as drivers, environmental awareness as motive, wastewater/discharge criteria, environmental co-benefits, climate vulnerability of infrastructure.
codes.exclusion_notes: Exclude resource endowment (resource-availability) and licensing procedures (regulatory-framework).
